title: Why Yawns Are Contagious, Even Over Video Calls
hook: Ever feel a yawn coming on just from seeing someone else yawn online?

narration.text: Your brain is hardwired to mimic certain actions it observes in others.
Contagious yawning is a form of unconscious social mirroring.
It is linked to empathy and our ability to connect with others' feelings.
When you see someone yawn, your brain's mirror neurons activate.
This stimulation can trigger a yawn response in your own body.
It happens regardless of physical proximity, even through a screen.
So, a friend's yawn on a video call can make you feel sleepy too.
What other unexpected things do you find yourself mirroring from others?

description: Discover the surprising reason why yawns are contagious, even when you are watching someone yawn on a video call. It is all about how our brains are wired for social connection and empathy.
